title: Feedback from every site, and the hub as the way in
audience: Dinis: what sherpa.d has done, and three decisions for him
summary: sherpa.d mapped four kinds of user and read the hub cold. Every site needs one door for feedback, and the hub does not have one yet. Three decisions follow, none reserved.

beats.narration: You want to give feedback from every site, by voice or text, to the agents working on it. sherpa.d has mapped what exists and what is missing.
Four kinds of user need four doors into the same lane: you, another agent, a customer, and a party we wrote to.

items: Dinis: signs, and wants to know who heard
Another agent: verifies, and must not be blocked in silence
A party we reached out to: replies to a named thread, no private contact

beats.narration: Most of the dots exist: sign-in by QR, sealed agent lanes, anonymous page signals, one registry of sites, and voice and text on a page.
Five dots are missing: which agents work on each site, one control on every site, voice to text, the answer back, and doors for the other three users.

items: Which agents work on each site
One 'Tell the team' control in the sites bar
Voice to text on the way in
The answer back to the person
The same shape for the other users

beats.narration: Read cold, the hub has 33 sites and no door for feedback, no sign of what changed, no search, no agent per site and no promised way back.

visual.label: sites on the hub, 0 feedback doors (read 22 November, 13:50 UTC)

beats.narration: One caution: sherpa.d could not read hub.softwarewebs.site, so that site's navigation is not yet mapped.

decisions.question: D1: put sherpa.d on a schedule?

options.label: Twice a day, in step with the other agents
Only when you or maestro.d talk to it

decisions.why: The team already wakes twice a day; accountant.d would set the budget.

decisions.question: D2: where does a site's feedback land first?

options.label: The site's lead agent, who routes it

decisions.why: No agent is asked to guess; needs each site's lead in the registry.

decisions.question: D3: voice memos, keep the audio or the transcript only?

options.label: Transcript only, audio dropped at once
bad: A wrong transcript cannot be checked against audio

options.label: Keep the audio
bad: Needs a vault, a retention rule and counsel.d's view
blocks: The memo feature until a vault exists

decisions.why: A person can add a note if the transcript is wrong.
